## Concept

What each family of assay measures, in what units, at what resolution, and the difference between a location and a neighbourhood.

**The assumption that breaks first.** That plotted point size has anything to do with the distance scale of the biology.

## Failure mode

**What it produces.** Two types are called co-localised from a plot whose marker size is larger than the distances involved.

**The diagnostic that catches it.** Replot with markers scaled to true microns and a scale bar; the apparent overlap disappears.
